body:
PR-2850 head 2e9eb5c966. main is merged in (no force), and every review item plus TASK-2220/2221 is fixed:
- TASK-2220 (b2c30d369e): commit_checks refuses anything but a full 40/64-hex SHA, with a clear error. Tested.
- TASK-2221: the TASK-1424 note is back above ci_status_from_glab_pipelines. A test pins it there.
- (1) portability: split_once(": "). check-portability.sh exits 0.
- (2) the golden help snapshot is regenerated (--if-main-green and the hidden --autopromote-child).
- (3) verify-manual.py passes against a freshly built aida-cli binary. The cause was 11-dev.md citing 'systemd-run --user', which the guard read as an aida flag; reworded.
- (4) ac3e63c0 is traced on the skip and promote tests, and ac481f1d on the config test. ac873b7a is anchored by a test on the guide's dev-build paragraph. 'aida criteria' shows no unanchored tests.
- (5) the routed last line now reads 'build of <sha> failed; log <path>; tail: ...'. Asserted in the test, and the route prompt is fixed.
- (6) a pure required_checks(ForgeKind) helper, tested, including green-without-the-aggregator => MissingRequired.
- (7) a 90s tick budget (under the 120s kill). The ff is skipped as 'out-of-time' unless 45s remain (ff bounded at 20s, plus systemd-run's 20s); fetch is bounded at 40s. Tests cover the skip and the budget arithmetic.
Gates (LIGHT): targeted aida-cli-lib tests (112 passed) and make check-ci-fast (34 gates) are green.
subject: READY: PR-2850 round 2 (STORY-1689)
